[b]Cyber attack[/b]
Around 5 hours after the cyber attack that disrupted an important coalition call, Hydronian security teams were able to track down the signal to a location. An island north of western shamat, Sikirsk. The signal had ties to a notorious group of hackers in Sikirsk, who are believed to be sponsored by the Sikirsk state. This has prompted Hydronia to classify Sikirsk as a dangerous nation and we encourage our allies to do the same. Sikirsks classification as a dangerous country now permits the Hydronian Military to conduct intelligence operations from within Sikirsk. 

With regards to the inquiry made into Goleornacha, no evidence of missile suppliers has been found(only money and ammunition, both of which Goleornacha openly admitted to), leading the intelligence service to believe that Sikirsk could be the one supplying the missiles, and blaming others to draw attention away from them and their shady behaviour.

[b]EFN evening news broadcast[/b]

Good evening, and welcome to Etherniasti Free News. I'm your anchor, Elenora Veyron.

We begin tonight with breaking news: Etherniasti is deploying troops to the Sal-Baliz region. The official announcement came from the Department of Defense just moments ago, citing escalating tensions and security concerns over the recent horrific attacks that struck our nation. The devastating assault on Port Thriump and a crowded shopping mall resulted in 612 tragic deaths, deeply shaking our community and prompting swift governmental action.

Sources confirm that the deployment includes air defense units, ground forces, and cyber warfare specialists, all tasked with stabilizing the region and neutralizing threats posed by the Sal-Baliz terrorists.

In an official statement, Defense Minister Esteban Valcazar emphasized, "This is not an act of aggression but a necessary measure to safeguard Etherniasti and our allies from imminent threats. We must prevent further tragedies like the heartbreaking attacks we recently endured." The Minister clearly stated there are currently no diplomatic channels open with the terrorist group.

Stay with us here on EFN as we continue to follow this rapidly developing situation, bringing you the latest updates as they unfold.

And in other news, an Etherniasti man has made headlines after attempting to ride a domesticated ostrich through downtown Port Verdigo during rush hour, all while wearing a full knights suit of armor and screaming that he was 'the rightful ruler of the asphalt kingdom.' Witnesses report that the man, identified as 42-year-old Jonas Mertov, was seen weaving through traffic at high speeds, brandishing a homemade lance made of PVC pipe and duct tape, while demanding that drivers yield to the bird-knights crusade. Authorities were eventually able to apprehend him near the central market, where he attempted to jump the fence into a petting zoo, still astride the bird, declaring that he needed to 'recruit more noble steeds' for his so-called avian cavalry. Local police confirmed that both Mertov and the ostrich were unharmed, though the ostrich is reportedly 'deeply traumatized' and has since refused to run in a straight line. Authorities are still determining if Mertov will face charges or be sent for psychological evaluation. Charges are pending.

Turning now to the weather, it looks like we'll enjoy nice and sunny conditions throughout the region. However, expect some local showers over the weekend in the northern regions and a dry spell in the southern coastal areas.

Thank you for joining us, and have a safe evening.

[nation]United Hydronia[/nation]
[nation]Sal-Baliz[/nation]
